note: Mapper-coverage invariant, docs/architecture/CHEMISTRY.md#mapper-coverage-invariant (D8, issue #105). Every continuous/discrete/convenience/coefficientArray parameter of the production module catalog has exactly one entry here. status 'mapped' = the production generator assigns it today from the listed drivers and ruleId appears in the generation trace; status 'provisional' = reachable and declared, coefficient explicitly uncalibrated, note names the owning leaf. An empty drivers list is a failure, not a status. Drivers are existing SonicIntent axes (density, brightness, rigidity, roughness, decay, harmonicity, motion) and structuralDetail fields (bondOrderMean, bondOrderSpread, heteroPlacement, motifPlacement); phase 4 adds no new analysis fields.
